text: if you don't play more than an hour, you get kicked out of the team you're in. it's easy at 1st, but after passing the first few tasks, it requires you to help the team and send help and sort your own camp. it was too fast for me to keep up. if you're a strategy person, this game is for you. if you're only playing to pass time, try another game instead.

Wish I had read more reviews! like others say, it starts off fun and interesting but so quickly becomes a carbon copy of other games, Iike Last War, with so few differences it's insulting. Micro transactions everywhere and non-stop tapping on red dots to collect minor rewards to give a minor boost to anything. Can see early on how they try to bait and switch and then throw in the daily/weekly/monthly packs and generic alliances etc. Avoid!

Starts off great, good story, loads of things to do, then you become introduced to the "the alliance" section of the game which turns it into a big co-op, battle against people who play it 24/7, start to order you around and THEN you realise the game just continues endlessly. There's no goal, just the want of people to try to get to the top, and to do what, be the most important leader...... of a computer game. I also bet those people pump a lot of money into the add ons and packs.
